cohort: The study included 109 women who experienced an unsuccessful first induction of labor with dinoprostone vaginal insert and subsequently received a second induction with either dinoprostone vaginal gel or oral misoprostol.
finding: Both dinoprostone vaginal gel and oral misoprostol were similarly effective in achieving active labor and vaginal delivery as a second induction after a failed first attempt, with a low incidence of adverse events.
mod_finding: The vaginal delivery rates were comparable for both dinoprostone vaginal gel (62.5%) and oral misoprostol (62.3%) as a second induction method.
